title: Shout the First Word
description: Learn how to change the case of text with an operator.

workspace.shout.txt:
word1 rest1
word2 rest2
ALREADY3 rest3
skip word4 rest4
aaa bbb ccc word5 rest5
word6 rest6

success.content:
WORD1 rest1
WORD2 rest2
already3 rest3
skip WORD4 rest4
aaa bbb ccc WORD5 rest5
WORD6 rest6

objective: The first line's first word needs shouting.
The second is identical — repeat the same change instead of redoing it.
The third is already shouting and shouldn't be — the opposite change is needed.
The fourth's word to fix isn't the first one on the line.
The fifth's word to fix is further out still.
The sixth is found by searching for it, not by counting lines.
